hypothesis: The CatBoost champion (Run 1, ROC-AUC 0.84974) exhibits moderate overfitting (Omega=11.27%) and lacks domain-enriched feature representations. Run 5 diagnostics confirm feature saturation (100% iteration utilization) and identify near-zero importance features (DeviceProtection_Yes, StreamingRatio). Introducing charge ratios, tenure cohorts, service density, and interaction terms will increase signal density, while increased L2 regularization (7.0), reduced depth (5), subsample bagging (0.8), and SqrtBalanced class weighting will constrain overfitting and improve minority class recall (FNR 46.5% in Run 5).
mathematical_justification: Generalization Gap (Run 1): Delta_gen ~0.045 (Omega=11.27%). Target Omega < 8% via L2_leaf_reg increase (3.0 -> 7.0) and depth reduction (6 -> 5) to penalize model complexity. Subsample=0.8 and bagging_temperature=0.5 introduce Bayesian bootstrap variance reduction. Learning rate reduced to 0.03 with iterations=1500 ensures convergence without saturation (Run 5 saturated at 100 iter). SqrtBalanced weighting optimizes PR-AUC under 26% churn imbalance by scaling gradients ~sqrt(N_maj/N_min). Pruning 2 zero-signal features reduces noise dimensionality.
expected_outcome: OOF ROC-AUC > 0.852 (+0.0023), OOF PR-AUC > 0.670 (+0.0046), Overfitting Index Omega < 8%, False Negative Rate < 40%.

hypothesis: The champion CatBoost model (Run 6) exhibits premature early stopping at 16.4% of iteration budget (246/1500) with a negative validation loss tail slope (-1.1e-5), indicating under-convergence. Lowering learning rate to 0.025 with increased iterations (2000) will allow the optimizer to navigate the narrow loss minima more precisely. Simultaneously, the 32% False Negative Rate and ECE=0.0696 suggest miscalibrated probabilities for the minority churn class; switching class_weight_mode from 'SqrtBalanced' to 'Balanced' will increase gradient magnitude for churn samples, directly targeting PR-AUC improvement. Feature enrichment via tenure cohorts (capturing non-linear tenure-churn hazard rates) and service density (encoding bundle complexity) will introduce high-order interactions missing from the current feature set, while pruning four near-zero importance features (PhoneService, TotalServices, SeniorCitizen, gender) reduces noise variance.
mathematical_justification: Generalization Gap = 0.0316 (Val 0.4626 - Train 0.4310), Omega = 6.82% — well within stable regime (<18%), confirming capacity for increased model complexity. Early stopping utilization = 16.4% << 25% threshold, violating the learning curve saturation criterion; learning rate reduction from 0.03 to 0.025 (within suggested bounds 0.025-0.05) increases effective step resolution by 20%. Val loss tail slope = -1.1e-5 < 0 confirms training had not plateaued. Class imbalance penalty: FNR=32% vs FPR=16.7% asymmetry; 'Balanced' mode applies weight = n_samples / (n_classes * n_samples_per_class) ≈ 1/0.26 ≈ 3.85 for churn class vs 1.35 for non-churn, directly optimizing the PR-AUC objective. Feature pruning removes 4 features with near-zero SHAP contribution, reducing dimensionality from ~20 to ~16, lowering variance term in bias-variance decomposition.
expected_outcome: ROC-AUC increase of +0.002 to +0.004 (target ~0.852-0.854) via deeper convergence and richer feature interactions; PR-AUC increase of +0.005 to +0.010 (target ~0.671-0.676) via Balanced class weighting addressing FNR=32% and improved calibration (ECE reduction from 0.0696). Overfitting Index expected to remain <10% due to L2=5.0 and bagging_temperature=0.3 regularization.

mathematical_justification: Generalization Gap (0.0266) and Omega (5.54%) are well below the 18% overfitting threshold, mathematically permitting capacity increase (Depth: 5->6). L2_leaf_reg increased proportionally (5.0->8.0) to constrain leaf weights in deeper trees per regularization theory. Learning rate reduced (0.025->0.02) with iteration budget expanded (2000->3000) ensures early stopping occurs >50% into budget, satisfying the learning curve plateau criterion (tail slope ~0). Feature pruning removes near-zero SHAP contributors, lowering VC dimension. Class weight 'Balanced' minimizes weighted log-loss gradient bias toward majority class, directly targeting PR-AUC improvement via recall enhancement.
expected_outcome: OOF ROC-AUC target > 0.8515 (+0.0015) via deeper interaction modeling; OOF PR-AUC target > 0.668 (+0.0036) via improved calibration (ECE reduction) and recall on minority class; Omega target 6-8% maintaining stability.
